newsitem.title: USA: PECO 1,100 MW Pa. nuke begins restart.
newsitem.headline: PECO 1,100 MW Pa. nuke begins restart.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's 1,100 megawatt (MW) Peach Bottom 2 nuclear unit has begun start-up operations from its refueling and maintenance outage, about one week earlier than expected, the company said Wednesday.
"We're in start-up mode. We're doing final testing, and we should be back in the next few days," said company spokesman Michael Wood.
The Delta, Pa., unit was shut on Sept 13 and was originally expected to be down for 30 days.
PECO and Public Service Enterprise Group Inc each hold 42.5 percent stakes in Peach Bottom, Atlantic Energy Inc and Delmarva Power & Light Co each hold a 7.5 percent stake in the complex.
